newsitem.title: USA: Negotiations to restart in Teamsters UPS strike.
newsitem.headline: Negotiations to restart in Teamsters UPS strike.

text.p: The Teamsters Union will resume contract negotiations with United Parcel Service Thursday, the Teamsters Union said Wednesday.
"We're going to meet with them tomorrow afternoon," a spokeswoman said.
A spokesman for the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service said that no time had been set for the meeting.

"Both sides agreed to show up," said the spokesman. "We don't have a specific time yet and we don't know who will be here." The meeting at the Washington headquarters of the service was called by John Calhoun Wells, chief of the service, he said.
The two sides have been under pressure from the White House to resume negotiations, which ended Sunday night.
